confirmationStatistics.method: Average all seats within each paired deal, then two deals per fixed cell, then equal cell weights. SE=sqrt(sum_c unbiased_sample_variance(delta_c)/2 / C^2); approximate normal 95% = mean +/-1.96 SE.
caveats: Conditional on each selected checkpoint and fixed opponents; two deals per cell give noisy variance estimates.
Map/count/rule/mapPlayers/cell intervals are descriptive, unadjusted multiple comparisons.
Germany uses exact reference; other maps use fixed PPO0/1/2. No Italy/Benelux transfer observations.
No significance gate, promotion, deployment, qualification or winner selection.

betweenReplicaDescriptive.note: Equal mean of the two independently selected-minus-teacher estimates; descriptive spread only. Spread includes training, checkpoint-selection-panel and evaluation-panel randomness, with no pairing between runs. No pooled SE, significance gate, ranking or zero-noise claim.

findings: Both independently selected policies improve on teacher-v2 overall and on every map mean in their own fixed confirmation panels.
Improvement is broad, not universal: replicas 1 and 2 have 8 and 12 negative individual-cell means. Replica 2 has a negative USA two-player map/count mean; all adverse cells remain reported.

An independent second calculation from raw confirmation and selection outcomes reproduces all 114 subset means, paired SEs and intervals per replica, and both checkpoint selections (maximum numerical discrepancy 2.22e-16).
Replica 1 selected update24; replica 2 selected update32. No replica was chosen as a winner, replaced, excluded or pooled with the historical run.
These confirmation comparisons are against teacher-v2, with historical-reference opponents on Germany and frozen PPO0/1/2 elsewhere; they do not replicate the PPO2 strong/mixed stress comparison.
Historical Germany reference superiority remains unestablished: both Germany selected-policy intervals include the balanced neutral credit of 0.29.

Both continuations only finished missing teacher-control confirmations. Complete model/optimizer/history/best/Python RNG transactions stayed unchanged, with exactly the inherited constructor-only Torch RNG advance.
limitations: Original seed is historical context only; its different/unequal transfer panel is not pooled.
Two independent training runs share pretrained representation and opponents but have disjoint game/RNG namespaces.
Between-replica differences include training, checkpoint-selection-panel and confirmation-evaluation-panel randomness; not pure training variance. Roots are NOT paired between replicas.
Macro is equal-cell-weighted win credit, including shared credit for ties, not an ordinary pooled game win rate.
Each replica has 640 games per confirmation arm but only 160 independent paired deal roots; all seats within a deal are a cluster. The 12,480 saved outcomes include training and checkpoint selection.
Normal 95% intervals are exploratory, unadjusted for multiple subgroup comparisons, with only two deals per full cell. Zero estimated subgroup variance is not proof of certainty.
Two runs cannot precisely estimate training variability; shared representation/opponents and independent selection/evaluation panels limit interpretation of between-run spread.
Germany-2 recharged/fast and USA-3 fast stress watchpoints remain unresolved by these different-comparator confirmation results.
Only four training maps were studied. Italy/Benelux and reserved final roots were unused.
Exact replays are integrity checks, not new independent strength observations. No optimization/gradient replay was performed; historical transitive dependencies are not fully pinned.
auditorCorrections: Startup-test mock events separated from production and runtime-ready receipt bound to the actual log.
Expanded source bound aligned privately with the frozen launcher (<256 MiB), without changing compressed/artifact limits (128 MiB) or old guards.

Expert-v2 environment validated against the complete Git-frozen real preflight, rather than absent older gap-protocol fields. Both incompatible full-audit attempts failed before issuing a success receipt.
conclusion: The unchanged recipe produced broad teacher-baseline gains in both independent end-to-end replicas. This is research replication, not qualification, human-strength evidence, historical-reference superiority, or a new stress gate.
nextResearchSuggestion: A separately budgeted fresh fixed stress evaluation of both frozen replicas could test opponent-population robustness and prior watchpoints without choosing a replica or tuning to these results. No further jobs have been launched or authorized.
